name: LordKnightmon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with [Knightmon] in its text from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
[All Turns] All Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon gain ＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
